name: Smuggler's Speronara

items.name: Maneuverable
items.text: With a full complement of skilled rowers, a rowed speronara can turn swiftly, turn in place, and even row backward. Each 90-degree turn made in less than a vehicle length costs 5 extra feet of movement. It can row backward no faster than half its speed, and it can't turn while rowing backward.

items.name: Smuggling Compartments
items.text: The speronara can hold up to 20 Bulk of items in secret compartments that require a successful DC 23 Perception check check to find.

text: This merchant craft has no deck and only one mast. It has a relatively shallow hull for storing cargo, but also several hidden compartments for smuggling illicit goods.
